findings.issue: The blockquote font has been changed to a serif typeface, which deviates from the clean, sober sans-serif system established in the reference design.
findings.fix: Change the blockquote font-family back to the primary sans-serif face, using only italics for emphasis as shown in the reference.

findings.issue: Every document, sheet, and folder icon in the left sidebar is colored in terracotta/orange, violating the 'neutral at rest' rule and diluting the agent focus accent.
findings.fix: Change sidebar icons to a neutral gray or white at rest, reserving color strictly for active states or specific agent indicators.

findings.issue: The SFT-RFT badge in the top header uses an orange border/text, adding unnecessary color noise to the global navigation.
findings.fix: Render the SFT-RFT badge in a neutral gray or low-contrast border style.
